Send the customer an acknowledgment no later than 2 business days after a written complaint arrives.

input.text: Call the customer back at a phone number already on file before releasing any outgoing wire of $10,000 or more. Outgoing wires over $50,000 need a second approval from an operations manager. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.

input.text: No more than three overdraft fees are charged to an account in one business day, generally. Refer an account for charge-off once it has been negative for 45 days, generally.

input.text: Resolve complaints within 15 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution. Resolve complaints within 30 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution. Escalate any complaint alleging unfair treatment to the regional manager on the day it is received.
